title: 第1章 被大师姐逆袭了第2章 合成九品上壮魂丹
slug: 人在废丹房我九阳圣体凭丹近神
content_zh:
;;
“师姐，不要啊！”
……
丹圣宗。
某丹房。
李安面如死灰的躺在地上。
他身旁则是一个绝色女修，此时正在捡起地上的衣服，一件件穿上。
“咦，竟然没死？”
这绝色女修妖媚入骨的声音有些意外，她看向“李安”：“小师弟，你很不错，最近这些日子好好调养，等过些日子，师姐再来找你~”
“对了，这炼丹房的废丹别忘了处理！”
……
砰的一下，绝色女修关门走了。
原地。
望着宁荣荣离开的背影，李安顿时有种都有种被狠狠羞辱的感觉。
糟蹋了自己的身体，夺走了自己宝贵的第一次，就这么穿上衣服，拍拍屁股走人？
一些丹药补偿都没有？
简直不将自己当人看！
甚至准备后续突破筑基时，又来榨取自己。
简直就是禽兽呀！
自己好歹也是穿越者，居然活成为工具人？

……
他是个穿越者。
刚被大运送到这个修仙世界时，李安其实还是很高兴的，毕竟哪一个男孩子没有一个御剑飞升的修仙梦？
尽管原主是五行废灵根，只是炼丹房杂役，甚至在炼丹房活生生地累死了。
可也算是宗门弟子，触及到了修行的门槛。
何况，炼丹师的地位极高，多少王侯将相、仙子佳人，为求一枚仙丹，愿意付出任何代价。
然而，他细细了解这丹圣宗之后，才发现这宗门看似是个炼丹为主的丹鼎派。
实际上却是个吃人不吐骨头的魔宗！
对他们这些外门弟子，极尽压榨，如同血汗工厂，将他们压榨至死，又会招一批新的牛马杂役。
就算是死了，尸体也要拿来炼丹，制作法器。
讲究一个人尽其材。
就比如现在。
他一个毫无人权的杂役，就被这个喜欢“以人为丹，滋补修行”的外门大师姐“宁荣荣”，给吸干了！
李安内心极为不甘！
自己好歹也是穿越者，说好的长生久视，道侣成群呢？
正在这时，佩戴在他颈间的一道香炉饰品，忽然有黑白二气在他眼前交织，勾勒成几道古朴的文字。
content_en:
;;
"Senior sister, no!"
…
Dan Sheng Sect.
A certain alchemy room.
Li An lay on the ground with a pale face.
Next to him was a stunning female cultivator, who was picking up the clothes on the ground and putting them on one by one.
"Hey, he's not dead?"
The charming female cultivator's voice was a little surprising. She looked at "Li An" and said, "Junior brother, you are very good. You have been taking good care of yourself these days. After a while, senior sister will come to see you again~"
"By the way, don't forget to deal with the waste elixirs in this alchemy room!"
…
With a bang, the stunning female nun closed the door and left.
In situ.
Looking at Ning Rongrong's leaving figure, Li An suddenly felt like he was being severely humiliated.
You ruined your body, took away your precious first time, just put on your clothes, pat your butt and leave?
Some elixirs are not compensated?
You simply don’t regard yourself as a human being!
Even when he was preparing to break through the foundation building later, he came to squeeze himself again.
They are simply beasts!
After all, he is also a time traveler, but he has become a tool man?
…
He is a time traveler.
When he was first transported to this world of immortality, Li An was actually very happy. After all, which boy doesn't have the dream of wielding a sword and ascending to immortality?
Although the original owner had five elements of useless spiritual roots, he was just a handyman in the alchemy room, and even died of exhaustion in the alchemy room.
But he can be regarded as a disciple of the sect and has reached the threshold of cultivation.
What's more, the alchemist's status is extremely high, and many princes, generals, fairies and beauties are willing to pay any price for an elixir.
However, after he got to know the Holy Alchemy Sect carefully, he discovered that this sect seemed to be an Alchemy Sect that focused on alchemy.
In fact, he is a demon sect that eats people without spitting out their bones!
They, the outer disciples, are squeezed to the extreme, just like a sweatshop. They will be squeezed to death and a new batch of laborers will be recruited.
Even if he is dead, his body must be used to refine elixirs and make magic weapons.
Pay attention to a person's ability to do his best.
Just like now.
He, a handyman with no human rights, was sucked dry by the outer sect sister "Ning Rongrong" who likes to "take people as pills to nourish their cultivation"!
Li An was extremely unwilling!
After all, I am also a time traveler. I promised to live forever and have a group of Taoist companions?
At this moment, the incense burner ornament worn around his neck suddenly had black and white energy intertwined in front of his eyes, outlines of a few simple words.
